grammar.purpose: Direct an action toward a recipient
grammar.explanation: 向当地朋友请教 identifies the person approached for advice, not a physical compass direction. 向大家介绍 directs an explanation to an audience. This unit contrasts the action recipient with 朝门口走 from the previous unit. Asking one person does not make their answer representative of everyone.

examples.py: xiàng dāng dì péng you qǐng jiào .
examples.en: Ask a local friend for advice.

examples.zh: 她向大家介绍自己的习惯。
examples.py: tā xiàng dà jiā jiè shào zì jǐ de xí guàn .
examples.en: She introduces her own custom to everyone.

examples.py: xiàng zhǔ rén wèn qīng chǔ shí jiān .
examples.en: Ask the host to clarify the time.

commonMistakes.wrong: 向朋友请教，所以所有人都这样做。
commonMistakes.right: 向朋友请教，再说明这是她的习惯。
commonMistakes.why: The recipient is an informant, not proof of universal practice.

grammar.purpose: Compare a stated feature without equating every feature
grammar.explanation: 像平时一样先问时间 compares the specific procedure of asking the time. 像朋友一样交流 compares a manner of interaction; it does not literally establish friendship. State the feature being compared. Avoid an analogy that turns a performance, ancient story or one host’s practice into a universal custom.

examples.py: xiàng píng shí yī yàng , xiān wèn shí jiān .
examples.en: As usual, ask the time first.

examples.py: dà jiā xiàng péng you yī yàng jiāo liú .

examples.zh: 这次的安排像上次一样。
examples.py: zhè cì de ān pái xiàng shàng cì yī yàng .
examples.en: This time’s arrangement is like last time’s.

commonMistakes.wrong: 像朋友一样交流，就是所有人已经是朋友。
commonMistakes.right: 像朋友一样交流，是比较交流方式。
commonMistakes.why: A comparison of manner does not establish actual identity.

lines.zh: 周日来我家做客吧，奶奶也在。
lines.py: zhōu rì lái wǒ jiā zuò kè ba , nǎi nai yě zài .
lines.en: Come to my home on Sunday. Grandma will be there too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好啊。几点来合适？
lines.py: hǎo a . jǐ diǎn lái hé shì ?
lines.en: I'd love to. What time would suit you?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 三点吧，先喝茶，晚饭一起吃。
lines.py: sān diǎn ba , xiān hē chá , wǎn fàn yì qǐ chī .
lines.en: Three. We'll have tea first and dinner together.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我带点水果？
lines.py: wǒ dài diǎn shuǐ guǒ ?
lines.en: Shall I bring some fruit?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 可以。奶奶喜欢橙子，我给你发地址。
lines.py: kě yǐ . nǎi nai xǐ huān chéng zi , wǒ gěi nǐ fā dì zhǐ .
lines.en: Sure. Grandma likes oranges. I'll send the address.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 她是不是喜欢听京剧？你以前说过。
lines.py: tā shì bú shì xǐ huān tīng jīng jù ? nǐ yǐ qián shuō guò .
lines.en: Does she like Peking opera? You mentioned it before.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对，周日下午她常听。你可以向她请教，她知道好多故事。
lines.py: duì , zhōu rì xià wǔ tā cháng tīng . nǐ kě yǐ xiàng tā qǐng jiào , tā zhī dào hǎo duō gù shì .
lines.en: Yes. She often listens on Sunday afternoons. You could ask her; she knows lots of stories.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我怕听不懂，她会不会笑我？
lines.py: wǒ pà tīng bù dǒng , tā huì bù huì xiào wǒ ?
lines.en: I'm afraid I won't understand. Will she laugh at me?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不会。我也常问，她每次都讲得很高兴。
lines.py: bù huì . wǒ yě cháng wèn , tā měi cì dōu jiǎng de hěn gāo xìng .
lines.en: No. I ask often too, and she's always happy to explain.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，那我带橙子，也带上问题。
lines.py: hǎo , nà wǒ dài chéng zi , yě dài shàng wèn tí .
lines.en: Okay. I'll bring oranges and some questions.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 问题不用装袋子，橙子要。
lines.py: wèn tí bù yòng zhuāng dài zi , chéng zi yào .
lines.en: No bag needed for the questions. The oranges need one.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 放心，橙子我会装好。
lines.py: fàng xīn , chéng zi wǒ huì zhuāng hǎo .
lines.en: Don't worry. I'll pack the oranges properly.
lines.speaker: b

reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 周日陈宇请我去家里做客，我三点到，带了一袋橙子。奶奶在客厅听京剧，见我进来，就把声音调小，招呼我坐下。
lines.py: zhōu rì chén yǔ qǐng wǒ qù jiā lǐ zuò kè , wǒ sān diǎn dào , dài le yī dài chéng zi . nǎi nai zài kè tīng tīng jīng jù , jiàn wǒ jìn lái , jiù bǎ shēng yīn diào xiǎo , zhāo hū wǒ zuò xià .
lines.en: Chen Yu invited me over on Sunday. I arrived at three with oranges. Grandma was listening to Peking opera in the living room; she turned it down when I came in and welcomed me.

lines.zh: 我问奶奶，这段讲的是什么。她指着屏幕，先介绍两个角色，再讲他们为什么在这里见面。我听懂以后，再看就有意思多了。
lines.py: wǒ wèn nǎi nai , zhè duàn jiǎng de shì shén me . tā zhǐ zhe píng mù , xiān jiè shào liǎng gè jué sè , zài jiǎng tā men wèi shén me zài zhè lǐ jiàn miàn . wǒ tīng dǒng yǐ hòu , zài kàn jiù yǒu yì si duō le .
lines.en: I asked Grandma what this scene was about. Pointing to the screen, she introduced the two characters and explained why they were meeting here. Understanding that made it much more interesting.

lines.zh: 陈宇端来茶，说他小时候也像我一样，总问同一个问题。奶奶说他那时更爱问，问完还要跟着唱两句。
lines.py: chén yǔ duān lái chá , shuō tā xiǎo shí hòu yě xiàng wǒ yī yàng , zǒng wèn tóng yī gè wèn tí . nǎi nai shuō tā nà shí gèng ài wèn , wèn wán hái yào gēn zhe chàng liǎng jù .
lines.en: Chen Yu brought tea and said he'd asked the same questions as a child. Grandma said he'd asked even more, then tried singing a couple of lines himself.

lines.zh: 我们聊到附近的公园。奶奶说国庆的时候，那里有京剧和武术表演，陈宇去年陪她看过。我说今年也想去，他们就让我到时一起。
lines.py: wǒ men liáo dào fù jìn de gōng yuán . nǎi nai shuō guó qìng de shí hou , nà lǐ yǒu jīng jù hé wǔ shù biǎo yǎn , chén yǔ qù nián péi tā kàn guò . wǒ shuō jīn nián yě xiǎng qù , tā men jiù ràng wǒ dào shí yì qǐ .
lines.en: We talked about the nearby park. Grandma said it had Peking opera and martial arts performances over National Day. Chen Yu had gone with her last year. I'd like to go this year too, so they invited me along.

lines.zh: 晚饭前，我帮陈宇把碗放好。他让奶奶再说一段，我才发现她不看屏幕，也记得那些人物的名字和话。
lines.py: wǎn fàn qián , wǒ bāng chén yǔ bǎ wǎn fàng hǎo . tā ràng nǎi nai zài shuō yī duàn , wǒ cái fā xiàn tā bù kàn píng mù , yě jì de nà xiē rén wù de míng zi hé huà .
lines.en: Before dinner I helped Chen Yu set out bowls. He asked Grandma to tell us another part. I realised she knew the characters' names and lines without looking at the screen.

lines.zh: 回家时，她塞给我两个橙子，说路上带着。我说本来是送给她的，她笑着说吃了一下午，还想让我明天也尝尝。
lines.py: huí jiā shí , tā sāi gěi wǒ liǎng gè chéng zi , shuō lù shàng dài zhe . wǒ shuō běn lái shì sòng gěi tā de , tā xiào zhe shuō chī le yī xià wǔ , hái xiǎng ràng wǒ míng tiān yě cháng cháng .
lines.en: When I left she gave me two oranges to take. I'd brought them for her, I said. She laughed that she'd had some all afternoon and wanted me to enjoy them tomorrow too.

lines.zh: 公共场所请文明用语。
lines.py: gōng gòng chǎng suǒ qǐng wén míng yòng yǔ .
lines.en: Please use courteous language in public places.

lines.zh: 奶奶给我讲了一个民间故事。
lines.py: nǎi nai gěi wǒ jiǎng le yī gè mín jiān gù shì .
lines.en: Grandma told me a folk tale.

lines.zh: 这里有民间音乐表演。
lines.py: zhè lǐ yǒu mín jiān yīn yuè biǎo yǎn .
lines.en: There's a folk music performance here.

lines.zh: 这本书介绍了几个民族的服饰。
lines.py: zhè běn shū jiè shào le jǐ gè mín zú de fú shì .
lines.en: This book describes the dress of several ethnic groups.

lines.zh: 展览里有不同民族的音乐。
lines.py: zhǎn lǎn lǐ yǒu bù tóng mín zú de yīn yuè .
lines.en: The exhibition includes music from different ethnic groups.

lines.zh: 她是住在国外的华人。
lines.py: tā shì zhù zài guó wài de huá rén .
lines.en: She's a person of Chinese heritage living abroad.

lines.zh: 当地的华人朋友邀请我们吃饭。
lines.py: dāng dì de huá rén péng you yāo qǐng wǒ men chī fàn .
lines.en: Our local friends of Chinese heritage invited us to dinner.

lines.zh: 这篇文章介绍中华民族的历史。
lines.py: zhè piān wén zhāng jiè shào zhōng huá mín zú de lì shǐ .
lines.en: This article introduces the history of the Chinese nation.

lines.zh: 他在课上读了一篇关于中华民族的文章。
lines.py: tā zài kè shàng dú le yī piān guān yú zhōng huá mín zú de wén zhāng .
lines.en: He read an article about the Chinese nation in class.

lines.zh: 这门课讨论现代社会的问题。
lines.py: zhè mén kè tǎo lùn xiàn dài shè huì de wèn tí .
lines.en: This course discusses issues in modern society.

lines.zh: 她喜欢研究社会变化。
lines.py: tā xǐ huān yán jiū shè huì biàn huà .
lines.en: She enjoys studying social change.

lines.zh: 广场上有一座人民纪念碑。
lines.py: guǎng chǎng shàng yǒu yī zuò rén mín jì niàn bēi .
lines.en: There's a monument to the people in the square.

lines.zh: 文章写了当地人民的生活。
lines.py: wén zhāng xiě le dāng dì rén mín de shēng huó .
lines.en: The article describes the lives of the local people.

lines.zh: 我想去看看更大的世界。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng qù kàn kàn gèng dà de shì jiè .
lines.en: I'd like to see more of the world.

lines.zh: 这张世界地图挂在墙上。
lines.py: zhè zhāng shì jiè dì tú guà zài qiáng shàng .
lines.en: This world map hangs on the wall.

lines.zh: 这座房子建于上个世纪。
lines.py: zhè zuò fáng zi jiàn yú shàng gè shì jì .
lines.en: This house was built in the previous century.

lines.zh: 故事发生在十九世纪。
lines.py: gù shì fā shēng zài shí jiǔ shì jì .
lines.en: The story takes place in the nineteenth century.

lines.zh: 电影讲的是那个时代的生活。
lines.py: diàn yǐng jiǎng de shì nà gè shí dài de shēng huó .
lines.en: The film is about life in that era.

lines.zh: 这是一个变化很快的时代。
lines.py: zhè shì yī gè biàn huà hěn kuài de shí dài .
lines.en: This is an era of rapid change.

lines.zh: 她喜欢读古代诗歌。
lines.py: tā xǐ huān dú gǔ dài shī gē .
lines.en: She enjoys reading ancient poetry.

lines.zh: 这幅画里的人穿着古代的衣服。
lines.py: zhè fú huà lǐ de rén chuān zhe gǔ dài de yī fú .
lines.en: The people in this painting wear ancient clothing.

lines.zh: 这座建筑很现代。
lines.py: zhè zuò jiàn zhù hěn xiàn dài .
lines.en: This building is very modern.

lines.zh: 我最近在读现代小说。
lines.py: wǒ zuì jìn zài dú xiàn dài xiǎo shuō .
lines.en: I've been reading modern novels recently.

lines.zh: 我想尝尝当地的菜。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng cháng cháng dāng dì de cài .
lines.en: I'd like to try the local food.

lines.zh: 我们向当地人问路。
lines.py: wǒ men xiàng dāng dì rén wèn lù .
lines.en: We asked local people for directions.

lines.zh: 国庆的时候，你回家吗？
lines.py: guó qìng de shí hou , nǐ huí jiā ma ?
lines.en: Will you go home for National Day?

lines.zh: 我们国庆准备去看展览。
lines.py: wǒ men guó qìng zhǔn bèi qù kàn zhǎn lǎn .
lines.en: We're planning to see an exhibition over the National Day holiday.

lines.zh: 今晚一起庆祝你的生日。
lines.py: jīn wǎn yì qǐ qìng zhù nǐ de shēng rì .
lines.en: Let's celebrate your birthday tonight.

lines.zh: 他们为新店开张庆祝。
lines.py: tā men wèi xīn diàn kāi zhāng qìng zhù .
lines.en: They're celebrating the opening of the new shop.

lines.zh: 周末来我家做客吧。
lines.py: zhōu mò lái wǒ jiā zuò kè ba .
lines.en: Come over to my home this weekend.

lines.zh: 第一次去她家做客，我带了一盒茶。
lines.py: dì yī cì qù tā jiā zuò kè , wǒ dài le yī hé chá .
lines.en: I brought a box of tea on my first visit to her home.

lines.zh: 她在大学里学习文学。
lines.py: tā zài dà xué lǐ xué xí wén xué .
lines.en: She studies literature at university.

lines.zh: 这个书架上都是文学作品。
lines.py: zhè gè shū jià shàng dōu shì wén xué zuò pǐn .
lines.en: This bookshelf holds works of literature.

lines.zh: 我小时候上过美术课。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu shàng guò měi shù kè .
lines.en: I took art classes as a child.

lines.zh: 学校有一个美术社团。
lines.py: xué xiào yǒu yī gè měi shù shè tuán .
lines.en: The school has an art club.

lines.zh: 奶奶很喜欢听京剧。
lines.py: nǎi nai hěn xǐ huān tīng jīng jù .
lines.en: Grandma loves listening to Peking opera.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次现场看京剧。
lines.py: zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì xiàn chǎng kàn jīng jù .
lines.en: It's my first time seeing Peking opera live.

lines.zh: 他每周去练武术。
lines.py: tā měi zhōu qù liàn wǔ shù .
lines.en: He practises martial arts every week.

lines.zh: 公园里有人在做武术表演。
lines.py: gōng yuán lǐ yǒu rén zài zuò wǔ shù biǎo yǎn .
lines.en: Someone's giving a martial arts demonstration in the park.

lines.zh: 她在镜头前很自然。
lines.py: tā zài jìng tóu qián hěn zì rán .
lines.en: She's natural in front of the camera.

lines.zh: 我们一起去看看大自然吧。
lines.py: wǒ men yì qǐ qù kàn kàn dà zì rán ba .
lines.en: Let's get out and enjoy nature.

audio.zh: 可以。奶奶喜欢橙子，我给你发地址。
audio.py: kě yǐ . nǎi nai xǐ huān chéng zi , wǒ gěi nǐ fā dì zhǐ .
audio.en: Sure. Grandma likes oranges. I'll send the address.

tasks.why: The heard line explicitly states this fact.

audio.zh: 回家时，她塞给我两个橙子，说路上带着。我说本来是送给她的，她笑着说吃了一下午，还想让我明天也尝尝。
audio.py: huí jiā shí , tā sāi gěi wǒ liǎng gè chéng zi , shuō lù shàng dài zhe . wǒ shuō běn lái shì sòng gěi tā de , tā xiào zhe shuō chī le yī xià wǔ , hái xiǎng ràng wǒ míng tiān yě cháng cháng .
audio.en: When I left she gave me two oranges to take. I'd brought them for her, I said. She laughed that she'd had some all afternoon and wanted me to enjoy them tomorrow too.

tasks.statement: Grandma gives the narrator no oranges to take home.
tasks.why: The heard line explicitly states a different result.

2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Naturalness correction: a quiet tea/book meeting for a tired friend, Grandma sharing opera stories over a home visit, correcting a west/east gate mistake with an apology and water, and a handmade birthday book bag/photo card. No identity, copyright or assessment-policy lecture inside ordinary speech. All 88 word records retain IDs and get two independent contexts; abstract/formal senses use suitable separate sentences. Self-review: Chen Yu offers the quiet venue; Grandma expects Sunday three and oranges; only Lin An goes to wrong gate, Chen Yu sends old address and fetches her; blue cloth, ordinary gold-coloured five-yuan button, birthday recipient Xiao Zhou, two books fit. Every false statement contradicts its own clip.
